name: Disable Tailored Experiences
description: Disables personalized tips and suggestions in Windows that rely on diagnostic data to show content tailored to your usage.

description_i18n.en: Disables personalized tips and suggestions in Windows that rely on diagnostic data to show content tailored to your usage.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert personalisierte Tipps und Vorschläge in Windows, die auf Diagnosedaten basieren, um Inhalte an Ihre Nutzung anzupassen.
description_i18n.fr: Désactive les conseils et suggestions personnalisés dans Windows qui reposent sur des données de diagnostic pour afficher du contenu adapté à votre utilisation.

warnings.title: Registry change
warnings.message: Persistent Windows settings may change until the tweak is restored

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Modifies the registry key HKCU:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\CloudContent by setting DisableTailoredExperiencesWithDiagnosticData to 1
